This notebook analyses relationships between biodiversity metrics and habitat extent metrics calculated from RF.

# Load libraries

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(broom)
library(MASS)
library(ggplot2)
library(corrplot)
library(performance)
library(robustbase)
library(quantreg)
library(ggside)
library(patchwork)
```

# Load data on habitat extent from random forest models

```{r}
RF_data <- readRDS(here("data", "clean", "RF_data.rds"))
```

# Load data from Nat. Comms. paper

From https://idata.idiv.de/ddm/Data/ShowData/3611

A pan-Europe dataset of estimated linear trends in multiple dimension of local plant diversity in 57,390 vegetation-plot time series.

```{r}
biodiv_perc <- read_tsv(here("data", "all_lm_trends_percentage_change_scale.txt"))
biodiv_perc
```

# Load data on CWMs

Data on percentage annual changes in CWMs per time_seriesID                                                    :

```{r}
CWMs <- read_rds(here("data", "CWMs", "all_rate_lm_tidy_fits_CWMs_for_Alicia.rds"))
```

```{r}
CWMs %>% distinct(metric)
```

CWM_PlantHeight.veg: CWM for plant height
CWM_RootingDepth: CWM for rooting depth			
CWM_LeafCN.ratio: CWM for leaf C:N ratio
CWM_LeafArea.leaf.undef: CWM for leaf area
CWM_SLA.undef: CWM for specific leaf area (SLA)

Rename to easier names:

```{r}
CWMs <- CWMs %>%
  mutate(metric = case_when(
    metric == "CWM_PlantHeight.veg" ~ "CWM_PlantHeight",
    metric == "CWM_RootingDepth" ~ "CWM_RootingDepth",
    metric == "CWM_LeafCN.ratio" ~ "CWM_LeafCNratio",
    metric == "CWM_LeafArea.leaf.undef" ~ "CWM_LeafArea",
    metric == "CWM_SLA.undef" ~ "CWM_SLA",
    TRUE ~ metric
  ))
```

# Load original data

```{r}
data_V2025.2 <- read_tsv(
  "C:/Data/MOTIVATE/MOTIVATE_data/Data/EVA and ReSurvey Data/2025 data - V2025.2/Core data/200_Motivate20250415_notJUICE_header_with_precise_coordinates.csv") %>%
  mutate(date = dmy(`Date of recording`), year = as.integer(year(date)))
```

# Data wrangling

## Join CMWs data to biodiversity data

```{r}
biodiv_perc <- bind_rows(biodiv_perc, 
                         CWMs %>%
                           dplyr::select(metric, time_seriesID, slope,
                                         initial_div_value, EUNIS_start, 
                                         EUNIS_end, year_start, year_end, n, 
                                         Trajectory, plot_size))
```

## Add columns for EUNIS1 (start and end) to biodiversity data

```{r}
biodiv_perc <- biodiv_perc %>%
  mutate(EUNIS1_start = str_sub(EUNIS_start, 1, 1),
         EUNIS1_end = str_sub(EUNIS_end, 1, 1))
```

## Fix plotIDs in RF_data

Gonzalo used RS_CODE instead of Resurvey project as first part of plot_id.

Retrieve list of correspondences of RS_CODE and Resurvey project from original data:

```{r}
correspondence_list <- data_V2025.2 %>%
  distinct(RS_CODE, `ReSurvey project`)
```

## Join extent and biodiversity data

```{r}
biodiv_extent <- RF_data %>% 
  # inner_join only joins records present in both
  # some are present in RF_data but not in biodiv_perc 
  # (e.g. DK presence-absence data)
  # some are present in biodiv_perc but not in RF_data 
  # (e.g. those not belonging to Q, R, S, T)
  inner_join(biodiv_perc, by = c("plot_id_spaced" = "time_seriesID"),
            relationship = "many-to-many")
```

## Check plots with extent from Mahalanobis and not from RF

```{r}
plotIDs_extent_Maha <- readRDS(here("data", "clean", "biodiv_extent.rds")) %>% 
  distinct(plotID)
plotIDs_extent_RF <- bind_rows(biodiv_extent %>% distinct(plot_id_spaced))
# Plots with extent from Mahalanobis and not from RF
plotIDs_extent_Maha %>%
  anti_join(
    plotIDs_extent_RF,
    by = c("plotID" = "plot_id_spaced")
  )
```

Only one, fine!

## Check if years match

```{r}
# Number of plots
biodiv_extent %>% distinct(plot_id) %>% nrow()
# Number of plots where first and last year match --> USE THIS SO FAR!
biodiv_extent %>% filter(first_year.x == year_start & last_year == year_end) %>% 
  distinct(plot_id) %>% nrow()
# Number of plots where first year does not match, but last year matches
biodiv_extent %>% filter(first_year.x != year_start & last_year == year_end) %>% 
  distinct(plot_id) %>% nrow()
# Number of plots where first year matches, but last year does not
biodiv_extent %>% filter(first_year.x == year_start & last_year != year_end) %>% 
  distinct(plot_id) %>% nrow()
# Number of plots where neither first nor last year match
biodiv_extent %>% filter(first_year.x != year_start & last_year != year_end) %>% 
  distinct(plot_id) %>% nrow()
```

In some cases, they do not match because the first or last observation in some time series did not have data on functional and/or phylogenetic diversity metrics (cf. Stephan's email). So far, we use only time series where first and last year match.

```{r}
biodiv_extent <- biodiv_extent %>%
  filter(first_year.x == year_start & last_year == year_end)
```

# Numbers of plots

```{r}
# Total
biodiv_extent %>% distinct(plot_id) %>% nrow()
# With constant habitat
biodiv_extent %>% filter(eunis_cambio == F) %>% distinct(plot_id) %>% nrow()
# with habitat change
biodiv_extent %>% filter(eunis_cambio == T) %>% distinct(plot_id) %>% nrow()
```

# Distributions

## Initial biodiversity values

### Plots with constant habitat

```{r}
# Histograms
biodiv_extent %>%
  filter(eunis_cambio == F) %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  mutate(
    q01 = quantile(initial_div_value, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    q99 = quantile(initial_div_value, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(initial_div_value >= q01, initial_div_value <= q99) %>%
  ggplot(aes(initial_div_value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "black", fill = "grey") +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free", ncol = 6) +
  theme_bw() + xlab("Initial diversity value")
```

# Correlations

## Correlations among initial biodiversity values

```{r}
biodiv_wide <- biodiv_extent %>%
  distinct(plot_id, metric, initial_div_value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = initial_div_value)
```

```{r}
cor_mat_init <- biodiv_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(-plot_id) %>%
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
corrplot(cor_mat_init, method = "color", type = "upper", addCoef.col = "black",
         number.cex = 0.6, tl.col = "black", order = "hclust")
```

## Correlations among biodiversity change metrics

```{r}
biodiv_change_wide <- biodiv_extent %>%
  distinct(plot_id, metric, slope) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = slope)
```

```{r}
cor_mat_change <- biodiv_change_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(-plot_id) %>%
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
corrplot(cor_mat_change, method = "color", type = "upper", addCoef.col = "black",
         number.cex = 0.6, tl.col = "black", order = "hclust")
```

# TBD: Try other model types instead of lm() for some variables

# Models change in EXTENT without OUTLIERS

Removing upper and lower 1% quantiles of biodiversity change values (slopes) and re-running the models.

## Effect of change in extent on change in diversity

```{r}
models_change_noout <- biodiv_extent %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  # Define quantiles
  mutate(
    q01 = quantile(slope, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    q99 = quantile(slope, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  # Reemove outliers
  filter(slope >= q01, slope <= q99) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ lm(slope ~ delta_focal_pct, data = .x)),
    coef = map(model, ~ tidy(.x) %>%
                 filter(term == "delta_focal_pct")),
    fit = map(model, glance),
    estimate = map_dbl(coef, "estimate"),
    p.value  = map_dbl(coef, "p.value"),
    r2       = map_dbl(fit, "r.squared"),
    n        = map_int(data, nrow)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(metric, model, estimate, p.value, r2, n)
```

```{r}
models_change_noout %>% filter(p.value < 0.05) %>% arrange(metric)
```

```{r}
plot_data_change_noout <- biodiv_extent %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  # Define quantiles
  mutate(
    q01 = quantile(slope, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    q99 = quantile(slope, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  # Reemove outliers
  filter(slope >= q01, slope <= q99) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  semi_join(
    models_change_noout %>%
      filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
      dplyr::select(metric),
    by = c("metric")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    models_change_noout %>%
      dplyr::select(metric, estimate, p.value, r2, n) %>%
      rename(n_obs = n),
    by = c("metric")
  )
```

```{r}
make_plot_change <- function(df){

  biodiv_name <- unique(df$metric)
  estimate <- unique(df$estimate)
  pval <- unique(df$p.value)
  r2 <- unique(df$r2)
  n_obs <- unique(df$n_obs)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = delta_focal_pct, y = slope)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", colour = "blue", fill = "blue", alpha = 0.15) +
    geom_smooth(method = MASS::rlm, colour = "red", se = FALSE) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1, size = 4,
             label = sprintf("β = %.3f\nR² = %.3f\np = %.3g\nn obs = %d",
                             estimate, r2, pval, n_obs)) +
    labs(title = paste0(biodiv_name), 
         x = "Change in habitat extent (%)",
         y = paste0("Change in ", biodiv_name), colour = NULL) +
    theme_bw()
}
```

```{r message=FALSE}
plot_data_change_noout %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  map(make_plot_change)
```

# Models change in FUNCTIONAL METRICS WITHOUT OUTLIERS

## Effect of change in functional metrics on change in diversity

```{r}
models_change_funct_noout <- biodiv_extent %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  # Define quantiles
  mutate(
    q01 = quantile(slope, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    q99 = quantile(slope, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  # Reemove outliers
  filter(slope >= q01, slope <= q99) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ndvi_resurvey, ndmi_resurvey, ndwi_resurvey, 
                        savi_resurvey),
               names_to = "rs_index", values_to = "rs_slope") %>%
  group_by(metric, rs_index) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ lm(slope ~ rs_slope, data = .x)),
    coef = map(model, ~ tidy(.x) %>%
                 filter(term == "rs_slope")),
    fit = map(model, glance),
    estimate = map_dbl(coef, "estimate"),
    p.value  = map_dbl(coef, "p.value"),
    r2       = map_dbl(fit, "r.squared"),
    n        = map_int(data, nrow)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(metric, rs_index, model, estimate, p.value, r2, n)
```

```{r}
models_change_funct_noout %>% filter(p.value < 0.05) %>% arrange(metric, rs_index)
```

```{r}
plot_data_change_funct_noout <- biodiv_extent %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  # Define quantiles
  mutate(
    q01 = quantile(slope, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    q99 = quantile(slope, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  # Reemove outliers
  filter(slope >= q01, slope <= q99) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ndvi_resurvey, ndmi_resurvey, ndwi_resurvey, 
                        savi_resurvey),
               names_to = "rs_index", values_to = "rs_slope") %>%
  semi_join(models_change_funct_noout %>% filter(p.value < 0.05),
            by = c("metric", "rs_index")) %>%
  left_join(models_change_funct_noout %>%
```

```{r}
make_plot_change_funct <- function(df){
  
  biodiv_name <- unique(df$metric)
  rs_index <- unique(df$rs_index)
  estimate <- unique(df$estimate)
  pval <- unique(df$p.value)
  r2 <- unique(df$r2)
  n_obs <- unique(df$n_obs)
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = rs_slope, y = slope)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", colour = "blue", fill = "blue", alpha = 0.15) +
    geom_smooth(method = MASS::rlm, colour = "red", se = FALSE) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.3, vjust = 1.1,size = 4,
             label = sprintf("β = %.3f\nR² = %.3f\np = %.3g\nn = %d",
                             estimate, r2, pval, n_obs)) +
    labs(title = paste0(biodiv_name, " | ", rs_index),
         x = paste0(rs_index, " Sen's slope"),
         y = paste0("Change in ", biodiv_name)) +
    theme_bw()
  }
```

## Effect of change in functional metrics for each habitat type

```{r}
models_change_funct_hab_noout <- biodiv_extent %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  # Define quantiles
  mutate(
    q01 = quantile(slope, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    q99 = quantile(slope, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  # Reemove outliers
  filter(slope >= q01, slope <= q99) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ndvi_resurvey, ndmi_resurvey, ndwi_resurvey, 
                        savi_resurvey),
               names_to = "rs_index", values_to = "rs_slope") %>%
  group_by(metric, rs_index, eunis1) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ lm(slope ~ rs_slope, data = .x)),
    coef = map(model, ~ tidy(.x) %>%
                 filter(term == "rs_slope")),
    fit = map(model, glance),
    estimate = map_dbl(coef, "estimate"),
    p.value  = map_dbl(coef, "p.value"),
    r2       = map_dbl(fit, "r.squared"),
    n        = map_int(data, nrow)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(metric, rs_index, eunis1, model, estimate, p.value, r2, n)
```

# Models change in EXTENT quantreg

First removing upper and lower 1% quantiles of biodiversity change values (slopes), then running the models using quantile regression.

## Define quantiles to be used in quantreg

```{r}
taus <- c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9)
```

## Check proportion of zeros and quantiles

```{r}
diagnostic <- biodiv_extent %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    prop_zero = mean(abs(slope) < 1e-10),
    q10 = quantile(slope, 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50 = quantile(slope, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    q90 = quantile(slope, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(slope, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(prop_zero))

diagnostic
```


## Effect of change in extent on change in diversity

### Function to get coefficients from quantile regression

```{r}
get_rq_coef <- function(mod) {

  tryCatch({

    s <- summary(mod)

    coef_name <- rownames(s$coefficients)[2]

    tibble(
      term = coef_name,
      estimate = s$coefficients[coef_name, 1],
      p.value = s$coefficients[coef_name, 4],
      method = "standard"
    )

  }, error = function(e) {

    tryCatch({

      s <- summary(
        mod,
        se = "boot",
        R = 50
      )

      coef_name <- rownames(s$coefficients)[2]

      tibble(
        term = coef_name,
        estimate = s$coefficients[coef_name, 1],
        p.value = s$coefficients[coef_name, 4],
        method = "bootstrap"
      )

    }, error = function(e2) {

      coef_name <- names(coef(mod))[2]

      tibble(
        term = coef_name,
        estimate = unname(coef(mod)[coef_name]),
        p.value = NA_real_,
        method = "failed_inference"
      )

    })

  })

}
```

### Models

```{r}
models_change_quantreg <- biodiv_extent %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  # Define quantiles
  mutate(
    q01 = quantile(slope, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    q99 = quantile(slope, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  # Reemove outliers
  filter(slope >= q01, slope <= q99) %>%
  nest() %>%
  crossing(tau = taus) %>%
  mutate(model = map2(data, tau, ~ rq(slope ~ delta_focal_pct, tau = .y,
                                      data = .x)),
         coef = map(model, get_rq_coef),
         estimate = map_dbl(coef, ~ .x$estimate[1]),
         p.value = map_dbl(coef, ~ .x$p.value[1]),
         sig = case_when(is.na(p.value) ~ "NA", 
                    p.value < 0.05 ~ "p < 0.05",
                    TRUE ~ "ns"),
         n = map_int(data, nrow),
         method = map_chr(coef, ~ .x$method[1])) %>%
  dplyr::select(metric, tau, model, estimate, p.value, sig, n, method)
```

### Function to plot quantile regression

```{r}
plot_quantile_metric <- function(metric_name,
                                 taus = c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9)) {
  
  # Datos
  dat <- biodiv_extent %>% group_by(metric) %>%
    mutate(q01 = quantile(slope, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
           q99 = quantile(slope, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    filter(slope >= q01, slope <= q99) %>% ungroup() %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name)
  
  # Colas para colorear puntos
  dat_plot <- dat %>%
    mutate(q10 = quantile(slope, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
           q90 = quantile(slope, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
           tail = case_when(slope <= q10 ~ "Lower 10%",
                            slope >= q90 ~ "Upper 10%",
                            TRUE ~ "Middle 80%"))
  
  # Modelos QR
  mods <- purrr::map(taus,
                     \(t) quantreg::rq(slope ~ delta_focal_pct, tau = t, 
                                       data = dat))
  
  # P-values ya calculados previamente
  pvals <- models_change_quantreg %>% filter(metric == metric_name) %>%
    arrange(tau) %>% pull(p.value)
  
  p_labels <- sapply(pvals,
                     function(p) {if (is.na(p)) {"p = NA"} 
                       else if (p < 0.001) {"p < 0.001"}
                       else {sprintf("p = %.3f", p)}})
  
  # Predicciones
  newdat <- tibble(delta_focal_pct = seq(min(dat$delta_focal_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
                                         max(dat$delta_focal_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
                                         length.out = 200))
  
  preds <- purrr::map2_dfr(mods, seq_along(mods),
                           \(m, i) {p <- pvals[i]
                           tibble(
                             delta_focal_pct = newdat$delta_focal_pct,
                             pred = predict(m, newdata = newdat),
                             tau = paste0("τ = ", taus[i],
                                          ifelse(is.na(p), " (NA)",
                                                 ifelse(p < 0.05, " *", ""))),
                             sig = case_when(is.na(p) ~ "NA",
                                             p < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
                                             TRUE ~ "NS"))})
  
  # Colores líneas QR
  tau_cols <- c("#6A3D9A", "grey60", "#E6AB02")

  names(tau_cols) <- unique(preds$tau)

  # Figura
  ggplot(dat_plot, aes(delta_focal_pct, slope)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +
    geom_point(aes(colour = tail), alpha = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_line(data = preds, aes(y = pred, colour = tau, linetype = sig),
              linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_ysidehistogram(aes(fill = tail), bins = 40, alpha = 0.8, 
                        colour = "grey50", show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Lower 10%" = "#6A3D9A", 
                                 "Middle 80%" = "grey80",
                                 "Upper 10%" = "#E6AB02")) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Lower 10%" = "#6A3D9A",
                                   "Middle 80%" = "grey80",
                                   "Upper 10%" = "#E6AB02",
                                   tau_cols),
                        breaks = names(tau_cols)) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Significant" = "solid", "NS" = "dashed",
                                     "NA" = "dotted"), guide = "none") +
    theme_bw() + theme(ggside.panel.scale = 0.3) +
    labs(x = "Change in habitat extent (%)",
         y = paste("Change in", gsub("\n", " ", metric_name)), colour = NULL,
         fill = NULL)}
```

### Function to get coefficients from quantile regression

```{r}
get_rq_coef_fast <- function(mod){

  out <- tryCatch({

    broom::tidy(mod) %>%
      filter(term == "delta_focal_pct")

  }, error = function(e){

    tibble()

  })

  if(nrow(out) == 0){

    return(
      tibble(
        estimate = unname(coef(mod)["delta_focal_pct"]),
        p.value = NA_real_,
        method = "fallback"
      )
    )

  }

  out %>%
    transmute(
      estimate = estimate,
      p.value = p.value,
      method = "standard"
    )

}
```

```{r}
                       "Species\nrichness")) %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  nest() %>%
  crossing(tau = taus) %>%
  mutate(
    model = map2(data, tau, ~ rq(slope ~ delta_focal_pct, tau = .y, data = .x)),
    coef = map(model, get_rq_coef),
    estimate = map_dbl(coef, ~ .x$estimate[1]),
    p.value = map_dbl(coef, ~ .x$p.value[1]),
    sig = case_when(is.na(p.value) ~ "NA", 
                    p.value < 0.05 ~ "p < 0.05",
                    TRUE ~ "ns"),
    n = map_int(data, nrow),
    method = map_chr(coef, ~ .x$method[1])) %>%
  mutate(eunis1 = "S") %>%
  dplyr::select(eunis1, metric, tau, model, estimate, p.value, sig, n, method)
```

### Function to plot quantile regression

```{r}
plot_quantile_metric_hab <- function(metric_name,
                                     model_table,
                                     data = biodiv_extent,
                                     taus = c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9)) {

  eunis_group <- unique(model_table$eunis1)

  if (length(eunis_group) != 1)
    stop("model_table must contain a single EUNIS habitat.")

  dat <- data %>%
    filter(eunis1 == eunis_group) %>%
    group_by(metric) %>%
    mutate(q01 = quantile(slope, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
           q99 = quantile(slope, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    filter(slope >= q01, slope <= q99) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name)

  if (nrow(dat) == 0)
    stop("No observations found for this metric.")

  dat_plot <- dat %>%
    mutate(
      q10 = quantile(slope, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
      q90 = quantile(slope, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
      tail = case_when(
        slope <= q10 ~ "Lower 10%",
        slope >= q90 ~ "Upper 10%",
        TRUE ~ "Middle 80%"
      )
    )

  mods <- map(
    taus,
    \(t) rq(slope ~ delta_focal_pct, tau = t, data = dat)
  )

  pvals <- model_table %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name) %>%
    arrange(tau) %>%
    pull(p.value)

  newdat <- tibble(
    delta_focal_pct = seq(
      min(dat$delta_focal_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
      max(dat$delta_focal_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
      length.out = 200
    )
  )

  preds <- map2_dfr(
    mods, seq_along(mods),
    \(m, i) {
      p <- pvals[i]

      tibble(
        delta_focal_pct = newdat$delta_focal_pct,
        pred = predict(m, newdata = newdat),
        tau = paste0(
          "τ = ", taus[i],
          ifelse(is.na(p), " (NA)",
                 ifelse(p < 0.05, " *", ""))
        ),
        sig = case_when(
          is.na(p) ~ "NA",
          p < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
          TRUE ~ "NS"
        )
      )
    }
  )

  tau_cols <- c("#6A3D9A", "grey60", "#E6AB02")
  if (length(unique(preds$tau)) != 3)
    tau_cols <- rep(tau_cols, length.out = length(unique(preds$tau)))

  names(tau_cols) <- unique(preds$tau)

  n_hab <- model_table %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name) %>%
    pull(n) %>%
    unique()

  ggplot(dat_plot, aes(delta_focal_pct, slope)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +
    geom_point(aes(colour = tail), alpha = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_line(data = preds,
              aes(y = pred, colour = tau, linetype = sig),
              linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_ysidehistogram(aes(fill = tail),
                        bins = 40,
                        alpha = 0.8,
                        colour = "grey50",
                        show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Lower 10%" = "#6A3D9A",
      "Middle 80%" = "grey80",
      "Upper 10%" = "#E6AB02"
    )) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(
        "Lower 10%" = "#6A3D9A",
        "Middle 80%" = "grey80",
        "Upper 10%" = "#E6AB02",
        tau_cols
      ),
      breaks = names(tau_cols)
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(
        "Significant" = "solid",
        "NS" = "dashed",
        "NA" = "dotted"
      ),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(ggside.panel.scale = 0.3) +
    labs(
      title = gsub("\n", " ", metric_name),
      subtitle = paste0("EUNIS ", eunis_group, " (n = ", n_hab, ")"),
      x = "Change in habitat extent (%)",
      y = paste("Change in", gsub("\n", " ", metric_name)),
      colour = NULL,
      fill = NULL
    )
}
```

# Models change in FUNCTIONAL METRICS quantreg

## Effect of change in functional metrics on change in diversity

### Models

```{r}
models_change_funct_quantreg <- biodiv_extent %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  # Define quantiles
  mutate(
    q01 = quantile(slope, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    q99 = quantile(slope, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  # Reemove outliers
  filter(slope >= q01, slope <= q99) %>%
  filter(!metric %in% c("No.of\nRed List species")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ndvi_resurvey, ndmi_resurvey, ndwi_resurvey, 
                        savi_resurvey),
               names_to = "rs_index", values_to = "rs_slope") %>%
  group_by(metric, rs_index) %>%
  nest() %>%
  crossing(tau = taus) %>%
  mutate(
    model = map2(data, tau, ~ rq(slope ~ rs_slope, tau = .y, data = .x)),
    coef = map(model, get_rq_coef),
    n = map_int(data, nrow)) %>%
  unnest(coef) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      is.na(p.value) ~ "NA",
      p.value < 0.05 ~ "p < 0.05",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(metric, rs_index, tau, model, estimate, p.value, sig, n, method)
```

```{r}
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "p < 0.05" = "black",
      "ns" = "white",
      "NA" = "red"
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

### Function to plot quantile regression

```{r}
plot_quantile_metric_rs <- function(metric_name,
                                    rs_index_name,
                                    taus = c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9)) {

  # Datos
  dat <- biodiv_extent %>%
    group_by(metric) %>%
    mutate(
      q01 = quantile(slope, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
      q99 = quantile(slope, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      slope >= q01,
      slope <= q99
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name) %>%
    mutate(rs_slope = .data[[rs_index_name]])

  # Colas para colorear puntos
  dat_plot <- dat %>%
    mutate(
      q10 = quantile(slope, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
      q90 = quantile(slope, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
      tail = case_when(
        slope <= q10 ~ "Lower 10%",
        slope >= q90 ~ "Upper 10%",
        TRUE ~ "Middle 80%"
      )
    )

  # Modelos QR
  mods <- map(
    taus,
    \(t)
      rq(
        slope ~ rs_slope,
        tau = t,
        data = dat
      )
  )

  # P-values calculados previamente
  pvals <- models_change_funct_quantreg %>%
    filter(
      metric == metric_name,
      rs_index == rs_index_name
    ) %>%
    arrange(tau) %>%
    pull(p.value)

  # Predicciones
  newdat <- tibble(
    rs_slope = seq(
      min(dat$rs_slope, na.rm = TRUE),
      max(dat$rs_slope, na.rm = TRUE),
      length.out = 200
    )
  )

  preds <- map2_dfr(
    mods,
    seq_along(mods),
    \(m, i) {

      p <- pvals[i]

      tibble(
        rs_slope = newdat$rs_slope,
        pred = predict(m, newdata = newdat),
        tau = paste0(
          "τ = ",
          taus[i],
          ifelse(
            is.na(p),
            " (NA)",
            ifelse(p < 0.05, " *", "")
          )
        ),
        sig = case_when(
          is.na(p) ~ "NA",
          p < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
          TRUE ~ "NS"
        )
      )
    }
  )

  # Colores QR
  tau_cols <- c(
    "#6A3D9A",
    "grey60",
    "#E6AB02"
  )

  names(tau_cols) <- unique(preds$tau)

  # n
  n_metric <- models_change_funct_quantreg %>%
    filter(
      metric == metric_name,
      rs_index == rs_index_name
    ) %>%
    pull(n) %>%
    unique()

  # Figura
  ggplot(
    dat_plot,
    aes(rs_slope, slope)
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = 2,
      colour = "grey50"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(colour = tail),
      alpha = 0.2,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = preds,
      aes(
        y = pred,
        colour = tau,
        linetype = sig
      ),
      linewidth = 1.2
    ) +
    geom_ysidehistogram(
      aes(fill = tail),
      bins = 40,
      alpha = 0.8,
      colour = "grey50",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Lower 10%" = "#6A3D9A",
        "Middle 80%" = "grey80",
        "Upper 10%" = "#E6AB02"
      )
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(
        "Lower 10%" = "#6A3D9A",
        "Middle 80%" = "grey80",
        "Upper 10%" = "#E6AB02",
        tau_cols
      ),
      breaks = names(tau_cols)
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(
        "Significant" = "solid",
        "NS" = "dashed",
        "NA" = "dotted"
      ),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      ggside.panel.scale = 0.3
    ) +
    labs(
      title = gsub("\n", " ", metric_name),
      subtitle = paste0(
        rs_index_name,
        " (n = ",
        n_metric,
        ")"
      ),
      x = rs_index_name,
      y = paste(
        "Change in",
        gsub("\n", " ", metric_name)
      ),
      colour = NULL,
      fill = NULL
    )
}
```

### Plots quantile regression

```{r}
plot_list <- models_change_funct_quantreg %>%
  filter(!metric %in% c("Cover of\nspecialists", "No. of\nspecialists",
                        "No. of\nRed List species")) %>%
  distinct(metric, rs_index) %>%
  mutate(plot = purrr::map2(metric, rs_index,
                            ~ plot_quantile_metric_rs(metric_name = .x,
                                                      rs_index_name = .y)))

metric_plots <- plot_list %>% group_by(metric) %>%
  summarise(combined_plot = list(wrap_plots(plot, ncol = 2)),
            .groups = "drop")

purrr::walk(
  metric_plots$combined_plot,
  print
)
```

## HERE: Effect of change in functional metrics for each habitat type

### Models

#### Q 

```{r}
models_change_funct_quantreg_Q <- biodiv_extent %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  # Define quantiles
  mutate(
    q01 = quantile(slope, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    q99 = quantile(slope, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  # Reemove outliers
  filter(slope >= q01, slope <= q99) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(eunis1 == "Q") %>%
  filter(!metric %in% c("No.of\nRed List species", "No. of\nspecialists",
                        "No. of\nnon-native species", "No. of\ngeneralists",
                        "Cover of\nspecialists", "Functional\nrichness",
                        "Functional\nevenness", "Functional\ndivergence", 
                        "Cover of\nnon-native species", 
                        "Cover of\nRed List species")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ndvi_resurvey, ndmi_resurvey, ndwi_resurvey, 
                        savi_resurvey),
               names_to = "rs_index", values_to = "rs_slope") %>%
  group_by(metric, rs_index) %>%
  nest() %>%
  crossing(tau = taus) %>%
  mutate(
    model = map2(data, tau, ~ rq(slope ~ rs_slope, tau = .y, data = .x)),
    coef = map(model, get_rq_coef),
    n = map_int(data, nrow)) %>%
  unnest(coef) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      is.na(p.value) ~ "NA",
      p.value < 0.05 ~ "p < 0.05",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(eunis1 = "Q") %>%
  dplyr::select(eunis1, metric, rs_index, tau, model, estimate, p.value, sig, n,
                method)
```

```{r}
  geom_point(aes(shape = sig, fill = sig), size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "p < 0.05" = 21,
      "ns" = 21,
      "NA" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "p < 0.05" = "black",
      "ns" = "white",
      "NA" = "red"
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

### Plots quantile regression

#### Function

```{r}
plot_quantile_metric_rs <- function(metric_name,
                                    rs_index_name,
                                    model_table,
                                    data = biodiv_extent,
                                    taus = c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9)) {

  # Infer habitat automatically
  eunis_group <- unique(model_table$eunis1)

  if(length(eunis_group) != 1)
    stop("model_table must contain a single eunis1 value.")

  # Data
  dat <- data %>%
    filter(eunis1 == eunis_group) %>%
    group_by(metric) %>%
    mutate(
      q01 = quantile(slope, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
      q99 = quantile(slope, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      slope >= q01,
      slope <= q99
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name) %>%
    mutate(
      rs_slope = .data[[rs_index_name]]
    )

  dat_plot <- dat %>%
    mutate(
      q10 = quantile(slope, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
      q90 = quantile(slope, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
      tail = case_when(
        slope <= q10 ~ "Lower 10%",
        slope >= q90 ~ "Upper 10%",
        TRUE ~ "Middle 80%"
      )
    )

  mods <- purrr::map(
    taus,
    \(t)
      quantreg::rq(
        slope ~ rs_slope,
        tau = t,
        data = dat
      )
  )

  pvals <- model_table %>%
    filter(
      metric == metric_name,
      rs_index == rs_index_name
    ) %>%
    arrange(tau) %>%
    pull(p.value)

  newdat <- tibble(
    rs_slope = seq(
      min(dat$rs_slope, na.rm = TRUE),
      max(dat$rs_slope, na.rm = TRUE),
      length.out = 200
    )
  )

  preds <- purrr::map2_dfr(
    mods,
    seq_along(mods),
    \(m, i) {

      p <- pvals[i]

      tibble(
        rs_slope = newdat$rs_slope,
        pred = predict(m, newdata = newdat),
        tau = paste0(
          "τ = ",
          taus[i],
          ifelse(
            is.na(p),
            " (NA)",
            ifelse(
              p < 0.05,
              " *",
              ""
            )
          )
        ),
        sig = case_when(
          is.na(p) ~ "NA",
          p < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
          TRUE ~ "NS"
        )
      )

    }
  )

  tau_cols <- c(
    "#6A3D9A",
    "grey60",
    "#E6AB02"
  )

  names(tau_cols) <- unique(preds$tau)

  n_metric <- model_table %>%
    filter(
      metric == metric_name,
      rs_index == rs_index_name
    ) %>%
    pull(n) %>%
    unique()

  ggplot(
    dat_plot,
    aes(rs_slope, slope)
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = 2,
      colour = "grey50"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(colour = tail),
      alpha = 0.2,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = preds,
      aes(
        y = pred,
        colour = tau,
        linetype = sig
      ),
      linewidth = 1.2
    ) +
    geom_ysidehistogram(
      aes(fill = tail),
      bins = 40,
      alpha = 0.8,
      colour = "grey50",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Lower 10%" = "#6A3D9A",
        "Middle 80%" = "grey80",
        "Upper 10%" = "#E6AB02"
      )
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(
        "Lower 10%" = "#6A3D9A",
        "Middle 80%" = "grey80",
        "Upper 10%" = "#E6AB02",
        tau_cols
      ),
      breaks = names(tau_cols)
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(
        "Significant" = "solid",
        "NS" = "dashed",
        "NA" = "dotted"
      ),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      ggside.panel.scale = 0.3
    ) +
    labs(
      title = gsub("\n", " ", metric_name),
      subtitle = paste0(
        eunis_group,
        " | ",
        rs_index_name,
        " (n = ",
        n_metric,
        ")"
      ),
      x = rs_index_name,
      y = paste(
        "Change in",
        gsub("\n", " ", metric_name)
      ),
      colour = NULL,
      fill = NULL
    )
}
```

# OLD

# RDA slopes CWMs ~ slopes functional metrics

## All

```{r}
cwm_wide <- biodiv_extent %>%
  filter(str_starts(metric, "CWM_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(plot_id, ndvi_resurvey, ndmi_resurvey, ndwi_resurvey, 
                savi_resurvey, metric, slope) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = slope) %>%
  # Remove NAs
  drop_na()
```

Response matrix:

```{r}
Y <- cwm_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(CWM_PlantHeight, CWM_RootingDepth, CWM_LeafCNratio, 
                CWM_LeafArea, CWM_SLA) %>%
  scale()
```

Explanatory variables:

```{r}
X <- cwm_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(ndvi_resurvey, ndmi_resurvey, ndwi_resurvey, savi_resurvey)
```

RDA:

```{r}
library(vegan)

mod_rda <- rda(Y ~ ndvi_resurvey + ndmi_resurvey + ndwi_resurvey + 
                 savi_resurvey, data = X)
```

```{r}
anova(mod_rda)
anova(mod_rda, by = "axis")
anova(mod_rda, by = "term")
```

```{r}
RsquareAdj(mod_rda)
```

```{r}
library(ggvegan)

autoplot(mod_rda, layers = c("species", "biplot"))
```

## By habitat

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)

rda_habitat <- biodiv_extent %>%
  filter(str_starts(metric, "CWM_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    plot_id, eunis1,
    ndvi_resurvey, ndmi_resurvey,
    ndwi_resurvey, savi_resurvey,
    metric, slope
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = metric,
    values_from = slope
  ) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  group_by(eunis1) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    rda = map(
      data,
      ~{
        Y <- .x %>%
          dplyr::select(
            CWM_PlantHeight,
            CWM_RootingDepth,
            CWM_LeafCNratio,
            CWM_LeafArea,
            CWM_SLA
          ) %>%
          scale()

        X <- .x %>%
          dplyr::select(
            ndvi_resurvey,
            ndmi_resurvey,
            ndwi_resurvey,
            savi_resurvey
          )

        rda(Y ~ ., data = X)
      }
    )
  )
```

```{r}
anova(rda_habitat$rda[[2]])

anova(rda_habitat$rda[[5]], by = "axis")

anova(rda_habitat$rda[[3]], by = "term")
anova(rda_habitat$rda[[4]], by = "term")
anova(rda_habitat$rda[[5]], by = "term")
```
